column1: # Unit 7 — This, that, where, questions
w212|哪|nǎ|which|你要哪个？|Nǐ yào nǎ ge?|Which one do you want?
w213|这些|zhèxiē|these|这些是我的书。|Zhèxiē shì wǒ de shū.|These are my books.
w214|那些|nàxiē|those|那些人是谁？|Nàxiē rén shì shéi?|Who are those people?
w215|哪些|nǎxiē|which ones|你喜欢哪些菜？|Nǐ xǐhuan nǎxiē cài?|Which dishes do you like?
w216|这儿|zhèr|here|你来这儿。|Nǐ lái zhèr.|Come here.
w217|那儿|nàr|there|我在那儿工作。|Wǒ zài nàr gōngzuò.|I work there.
w219|这里|zhèlǐ|here|这里很漂亮。|Zhèlǐ hěn piàoliang.|It's beautiful here.
w220|那里|nàlǐ|there|那里有很多人。|Nàlǐ yǒu hěn duō rén.|There are lots of people there.
w221|哪里|nǎlǐ|where|你家在哪里？|Nǐ jiā zài nǎlǐ?|Where is your home?
w222|这边|zhèbiān|this side; over here|请到这边来。|Qǐng dào zhèbiān lái.|Please come over here.
w223|那边|nàbiān|that side; over there|商店在那边。|Shāngdiàn zài nàbiān.|The store is over there.
w224|边|biān|side|我坐你边上。|Wǒ zuò nǐ biān shang.|I'll sit beside you.
w226|怎么|zěnme|how; why|这个字怎么读？|Zhège zì zěnme dú?|How do you read this character?
w227|怎么样|zěnmeyàng|how about; how is it|明天去怎么样？|Míngtiān qù zěnmeyàng?|How about going tomorrow?
# Unit 8 — Places & directions
w228|上|shàng|up; on; last|书在桌子上。|Shū zài zhuōzi shang.|The book is on the table.
w229|下|xià|down; under; next|猫在椅子下。|Māo zài yǐzi xià.|The cat is under the chair.
w230|里|lǐ|inside|妈妈在房间里。|Māma zài fángjiān lǐ.|Mom is in the room.
w231|外|wài|outside|他是外国人。|Tā shì wàiguó rén.|He's a foreigner.
w232|外边|wàibian|outside|孩子们在外边玩。|Háizimen zài wàibian wán.|The kids are playing outside.
w233|学校|xuéxiào|school|我们的学校很大。|Wǒmen de xuéxiào hěn dà.|Our school is very big.
w234|大学|dàxué|university|她在大学学习。|Tā zài dàxué xuéxí.|She studies at university.
w235|中学|zhōngxué|middle/high school|我弟弟上中学。|Wǒ dìdi shàng zhōngxué.|My younger brother is in high school.
w236|小学|xiǎoxué|elementary school|我家前边有一个小学。|Wǒ jiā qiánbian yǒu yí ge xiǎoxué.|There's an elementary school in front of my home.
w237|公司|gōngsī|company|我在公司工作。|Wǒ zài gōngsī gōngzuò.|I work at a company.
w238|医院|yīyuàn|hospital|医院在哪儿？|Yīyuàn zài nǎr?|Where is the hospital?
w239|商店|shāngdiàn|store|这个商店很大。|Zhège shāngdiàn hěn dà.|This store is very big.
w240|店|diàn|shop|这家店卖什么？|Zhè jiā diàn mài shénme?|What does this shop sell?
w241|超市|chāoshì|supermarket|我去超市买水果。|Wǒ qù chāoshì mǎi shuǐguǒ.|I'm going to the supermarket to buy fruit.
w242|书店|shūdiàn|bookstore|书店在学校前边。|Shūdiàn zài xuéxiào qiánbian.|The bookstore is in front of the school.
w243|电影院|diànyǐngyuàn|cinema|我们去电影院吧。|Wǒmen qù diànyǐngyuàn ba.|Let's go to the cinema.
w244|房间|fángjiān|room|我的房间很小。|Wǒ de fángjiān hěn xiǎo.|My room is small.
# Unit 9 — Things
w245|东西|dōngxi|thing; stuff|你买什么东西？|Nǐ mǎi shénme dōngxi?|What are you buying?
w063|本|běn|(measure word for books)|我买了两本书。|Wǒ mǎi le liǎng běn shū.|I bought two books.
w247|字|zì|character; word|这个字我不认识。|Zhège zì wǒ bú rènshi.|I don't know this character.
w248|汉字|Hànzì|Chinese character|汉字很漂亮。|Hànzì hěn piàoliang.|Chinese characters are beautiful.
w249|汉语|Hànyǔ|Chinese (language)|你会说汉语吗？|Nǐ huì shuō Hànyǔ ma?|Can you speak Chinese?
w250|中文|Zhōngwén|Chinese (language)|我在学中文。|Wǒ zài xué Zhōngwén.|I'm learning Chinese.
w251|课|kè|class; lesson|今天有汉语课。|Jīntiān yǒu Hànyǔ kè.|There's Chinese class today.
w252|手机|shǒujī|cell phone|我的手机在哪儿？|Wǒ de shǒujī zài nǎr?|Where's my phone?
w053|千|qiān|thousand|这个手机三千块。|Zhège shǒujī sānqiān kuài.|This phone is 3,000 yuan.
w253|电话|diànhuà|telephone|你的电话！|Nǐ de diànhuà!|Your phone's ringing!
w051|零|líng|zero|我的电话是六八零九。|Wǒ de diànhuà shì liù bā líng jiǔ.|My phone number is 6809.
w254|电脑|diànnǎo|computer|这是我的新电脑。|Zhè shì wǒ de xīn diànnǎo.|This is my new computer.
w255|电视|diànshì|television|我不喜欢看电视。|Wǒ bù xǐhuan kàn diànshì.|I don't like watching TV.
w256|电影|diànyǐng|movie|我们去看电影吧。|Wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng ba.|Let's go see a movie.
w257|衣服|yīfu|clothes|我想买新衣服。|Wǒ xiǎng mǎi xīn yīfu.|I want to buy new clothes.
w052|百|bǎi|hundred|这件衣服一百块。|Zhè jiàn yīfu yìbǎi kuài.|This piece of clothing is 100 yuan.
w258|桌子|zhuōzi|table; desk|桌子上有一个杯子。|Zhuōzi shang yǒu yí ge bēizi.|There's a cup on the table.
w259|椅子|yǐzi|chair|这个椅子很小。|Zhège yǐzi hěn xiǎo.|This chair is small.
w260|车|chē|vehicle; car|这是我的车。|Zhè shì wǒ de chē.|This is my car.
w261|出租车|chūzūchē|taxi|我们坐出租车吧。|Wǒmen zuò chūzūchē ba.|Let's take a taxi.
w262|火车|huǒchē|train|我们坐火车去吧。|Wǒmen zuò huǒchē qù ba.|Let's take the train.
w263|飞机|fēijī|airplane|我坐飞机去中国。|Wǒ zuò fēijī qù Zhōngguó.|I'm flying to China.
w264|事|shì|matter; thing to do|你有什么事？|Nǐ yǒu shénme shì?|What's up? / What do you need?
# Unit 10 — Describing things
w265|大|dà|big|这个房间很大。|Zhège fángjiān hěn dà.|This room is big.
w266|小|xiǎo|small|我的狗很小。|Wǒ de gǒu hěn xiǎo.|My dog is small.
w267|新|xīn|new|这是新手机。|Zhè shì xīn shǒujī.|This is a new phone.
w268|贵|guì|expensive|这个太贵了！|Zhège tài guì le!|This is too expensive!
w269|便宜|piányi|cheap|这个很便宜。|Zhège hěn piányi.|This is cheap.
w270|漂亮|piàoliang|pretty|你的衣服很漂亮。|Nǐ de yīfu hěn piàoliang.|Your clothes are pretty.
w064|件|jiàn|(measure word for clothes, matters)|这件衣服很漂亮。|Zhè jiàn yīfu hěn piàoliang.|This piece of clothing is very pretty.
w271|好看|hǎokàn|good-looking; good (to watch)|这个电影很好看。|Zhège diànyǐng hěn hǎokàn.|This movie is good.
w272|好听|hǎotīng|nice to hear|她唱歌很好听。|Tā chàng gē hěn hǎotīng.|She sings beautifully.
w273|好玩儿|hǎowánr|fun|中国很好玩儿。|Zhōngguó hěn hǎowánr.|China is a lot of fun.
w275|冷|lěng|cold|今天很冷。|Jīntiān hěn lěng.|It's cold today.
w276|热|rè|hot|今天太热了。|Jīntiān tài rè le.|It's too hot today.
w277|病|bìng|illness; sick|他病了。|Tā bìng le.|He's sick.
w278|生病|shēng bìng|to get sick|我生病了。|Wǒ shēng bìng le.|I got sick.
w279|看病|kàn bìng|to see a doctor|我下午去看病。|Wǒ xiàwǔ qù kàn bìng.|I'm seeing a doctor this afternoon.
w280|天气|tiānqì|weather|今天天气怎么样？|Jīntiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng?|How's the weather today?
w281|雨|yǔ|rain|雨很大。|Yǔ hěn dà.|The rain is heavy.
w282|下雨|xià yǔ|to rain|明天会下雨。|Míngtiān huì xià yǔ.|It will rain tomorrow.
w283|雪|xuě|snow|明天会下雪。|Míngtiān huì xià xuě.|It will snow tomorrow.
# Unit 11 — Adverbs & particles
w286|非常|fēicháng|extremely|我非常喜欢中国菜。|Wǒ fēicháng xǐhuan Zhōngguó cài.|I really love Chinese food.
w287|真|zhēn|really|你真好！|Nǐ zhēn hǎo!|You're so kind!
w288|再|zài|again|我明天再来。|Wǒ míngtiān zài lái.|I'll come again tomorrow.
w289|还|hái|still; also|我还没有吃饭。|Wǒ hái méiyǒu chī fàn.|I haven't eaten yet.
w290|正在|zhèngzài|in the middle of (doing)|我正在吃饭。|Wǒ zhèngzài chī fàn.|I'm eating right now.
w291|对|duì|correct; toward|对，我是学生。|Duì, wǒ shì xuésheng.|Yes, I'm a student.
